about: Law Lens map from old ADU statute numbers to current ones. Every mapping is quoted from the HCD ADU Handbook (March 2026), read 2026-11-07 from data/raw/hcd-adu-handbook-2026-03.pdf; source_url points at the page. confirmed stays false until a person on the team checks the entry and says so. The Handbook maps the four old numbers to the whole range 66310-66342, not to single sections, so Law Lens must show the range.
